spells.descCn: 瞬发，10分钟冷却时间。38级时为2级：在15秒内消耗你自身720点生命值，以获得720点法力值。1级：消耗532点生命值，获得440点法力值。
spells.name: Dark Sacrifice
spells.desc: Instant, 10 min cooldown. Rank 2 at 38: cannibalize 720 of your own health over 15 sec to gain 720 mana. Rank 1: 532 health for 440 mana.

spells.descCn: 1级：12点法力值，瞬发。下一次对你发动的近战攻击将对攻击者造成20点暗影伤害，并使其近战攻击强度降低43点，持续2分钟。
spells.name: Touch of Weakness
spells.desc: Rank 1: 12 mana, instant. The next melee attack against you deals 20 Shadow damage to the attacker and cuts their melee attack power by 43 for 2 min.

spells.descCn: 已改动。38级时为3级：45点法力值，瞬发，30码。使目标的近战攻击强度降低85点，其受到的治疗效果降低20%，持续2分钟。1级为35点法力值，降低43点攻击强度。（经典旧世中降低的是固定的近战伤害，而非攻击强度。）
spells.name: Hex of Weakness
spells.desc: Changed. Rank 3 at 38: 45 mana, instant, 30 yd. Reduces the target's melee attack power by 85 and the effectiveness of healing on it by 20% for 2 min. Rank 1 is 35 mana and 43 attack power. (Classic reduced flat melee damage instead of attack power.)

spells.descCn: 38级时为3级：30点法力值，瞬发。任何以法术、近战或远程攻击击中你的敌人都会遭到暗影反击，受到76点暗影伤害，每隔几秒最多触发一次，不产生威胁值。3层充能，持续10分钟。1级为50点法力值，造成34点伤害。
spells.name: Shadowguard
spells.desc: Rank 3 at 38: 30 mana, instant. Shadows strike anyone who hits you with a spell, melee or ranged attack for 76 Shadow damage, once every few seconds, no threat. 3 charges, lasts 10 min. Rank 1 is 50 mana and 34 damage.

spells.descCn: 1级：50点法力值，瞬发，20码，2分钟冷却时间。造成50到57点神圣伤害，并使目标定身最多2秒。只对人型生物有效，威胁值极低。设计思路与燃烧的远征相同。
spells.name: Chastise
spells.desc: Rank 1: 50 mana, instant, 20 yd, 2 min cooldown. 50 to 57 Holy damage and roots the target for up to 2 sec. Humanoids only, very low threat. Same idea as TBC.

spells.descCn: 1级：瞬发，10分钟冷却时间。为你治疗220到257点生命值。
spells.name: Desperate Prayer
spells.desc: Rank 1: instant, 10 min cooldown. Heals you for 220 to 257.

spells.descCn: 新增。1级：26点法力值，0.5秒施法时间，2分钟冷却时间。使8码范围内最多5个敌人陷入混乱，持续3秒。受到任何伤害都会解除该效果。
spells.name: Confounding Flash
spells.desc: New. Rank 1: 26 mana, 0.5 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Confuses up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec. Any damage breaks it.

spells.descCn: 新增。38级时为2级：220点法力值，瞬发，30码，10分钟冷却时间。在一名友方目标身上放置一道神圣结界，持续15秒；下一次使其生命值降至35%以下的攻击将为其提供290点伤害吸收，并在15秒内为其治疗338点生命值。每个目标只能拥有一个。1级为130点法力值，吸收155点，治疗300点。
spells.name: Contingency Plan
spells.desc: New. Rank 2 at 38: 220 mana, instant, 30 yd, 10 min cooldown. Places a Holy ward on an ally for 15 sec; the next hit that drops them below 35% health gives them a 290 absorb and heals 338 over 15 sec. One per target. Rank 1 is 130 mana, 155 absorb, 300 heal.

spells.descCn: 新增。1级：瞬发，40码，10分钟冷却时间。为一名生命值低于50%的友方目标治疗220到257点生命值，并移除其身上的虚弱灵魂效果。不能对自己施放。
spells.name: Divine Grace
spells.desc: New. Rank 1: instant, 40 yd, 10 min cooldown. Heals a friendly target below 50% health for 220 to 257 and removes Weakened Soul from them. Cannot be cast on yourself.

spells.descCn: 1级：55点法力值，瞬发，3分钟冷却时间。在15秒内，任何击中你的法术都会燃烧攻击者18点法力值，并且每燃烧1点法力值造成1点暗影伤害。
spells.name: Feedback
spells.desc: Rank 1: 55 mana, instant, 3 min cooldown. For 15 sec, any spell that hits you burns 18 of the attacker's mana and deals 1 Shadow damage per point burned.

spells.descCn: 已改动。瞬发，26点法力值，5分钟冷却：使你被近战和远程攻击命中的几率降低50%，持续15秒或直到有3次攻击未命中你为止。（经典旧世：仅对远程攻击生效，并提高躲闪几率，3分钟冷却。）读自38级时的试玩版法术书。
spells.name: Elune's Grace
spells.desc: Changed. Instant, 26 mana, 5 min cooldown: reduces the chance you will be hit by melee and ranged attacks by 50% for 15 sec or until you are missed 3 times. (Classic: ranged only, plus dodge, 3 min cooldown.) Read from the demo spellbook at level 38.

spells.descCn: 已改动。38级时为4级：190点法力值，30码，引导，30秒冷却时间。使星辰碎片如雨般落向目标，在6秒内造成816点奥术伤害。1级为50点法力值，造成216点伤害。（经典旧世：没有冷却时间，伤害也低得多。）
spells.name: Starshards
spells.desc: Changed. Rank 4 at 38: 190 mana, 30 yd, channeled, 30 sec cooldown. Rains starshards on the target for 816 Arcane damage over 6 sec. Rank 1 is 50 mana for 216. (Classic: no cooldown and far less damage.)
